answer.read: Selvbrunn is the single source under a head-office freeze on price reductions [Z price_frozen; S e-mail]. It still moved from €441.89 to €432.15 by trading terms, after accepting our verified volume and should-cost data [S verdict; A check]. Its strong needs are planning security and price stability [Z], and it values our 90-day, 36-month package [S offer:70530-1]. Its full cost is about €403 [E], so the margin at the current price is thin but sustainable. It is open to term trades and has not issued a final_offer.
answer.message: Thank you for moving on the terms. We are prepared to keep the longer commitment and the payment period you proposed, which gives you the planning security your plant needs. On that basis we ask you to close the remaining small gap so we can finalise the renewal now.
answer.reason: E0 keeps the 90-day, 36-month, vol 4,580 terms the supplier itself priced, at a slightly lower price. It costs the supplier only -0.2% against its own sheet, so it is likely accepted and gives our lowest C among the options. Price is already near the health price at the top of its range, so pushing harder risks the relationship charge and a stall under the freeze. o1 has the same C but shortens the term the supplier values. The 60-day and shorter-payment options all cost us more. Citing our order history reinforces that the price has risen above what we paid before.

## SUPPLIER
[D] Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH (sup:70530), DE, owner type group; contract ctr:4600070530.
[E] Its full cost: estimate €403.15/unit, range €383.05-€403.15. Source: should-cost of its plant (cost:350020), capped by its opening quote at the sustainable margin (an assumption: it held in every practice case we could check); the data's should-cost carries about ±5 %.
[E] Its cost of money: unknown until two of its sheets differ only in payment days. The prices below assume 5.0 %/yr (our owner-type guess, which missed by up to 3 points in practice).
[Z] Need: planning_security (strong): Wants our expected volumes and call-off discipline; the renewal mail asks for volumes, and the plant shutdown requires early January call-offs. (doc:20260917-70530-P03, doc:20251201-70530-N, fc:350020@2026-09)
[Z] Need: price_stability (strong): Faces real rises in electronics and copper; will push for an increase or an index clause, and cannot cut price under the head-office freeze. (idx:PPI-C2611@2026-08, idx:CU-NOTATION@2026-09, quote:7300003, doc:20260826-70530-M1)
[Z] Need: cash (moderate): Not distressed, but the sales director was explicitly open on payment terms. The current 30 days already beats our 60-day standard, and punctual payment is valued. (doc:20260826-70530-M1, ctr:4600070530#4.1)
[Z] Need: volume (moderate): Forecast growth on part:350020 plus possible 15 kW volume (part:350021, where it is qualified at 0% quota). (fc:350020@2026-09, quote:7100053, rfq:6000000125)
[Z] Constraint: price_frozen: Head office has frozen all price reductions until December 2027; the quote states discounts are not possible. (doc:20260826-70530-M1, quote:7300003)
[Z] Constraint: approval_needed: Price changes above 2% need the pricing committee, which meets every two weeks. Plan the timeline around it. (doc:20260909-70530-M2)
[Z] Constraint: single_source: 100% quota. The only alternative, Konvertek, is much dearer with a far longer lead time. (quote:7200003, rfq:6000000203)
[Z] Constraint: contract_binding: Prices are fixed per calendar year, and changes need 90 days' written notice before year end. Auto-renewal applies unless terminated by early October. (ctr:4600070530#3.1, ctr:4600070530#8.1)
